export default "---\ntitle: \"React Hooks深度解析 - 高级Hooks与自定义Hooks\"\nexcerpt: \"深入探讨React Hooks的高级用法和自定义Hooks的开发技巧，帮助你更灵活地使用Hooks\"\ncoverImage: \"/assets/blog/preview/cover.jpg\"\ndate: \"2025-10-12\"\nauthor:\n  name: 小羽\n  picture: \"/assets/blog/authors/jj.jpeg\"\nogImage:\n  url: \"/assets/blog/preview/cover.jpg\"\n---\n\n# React Hooks深度解析 - 高级Hooks与自定义Hooks\n\n## 高级Hooks详解\n\n### useCallback Hook\n\nuseCallback用于缓存函数，避免不必要的重新创建。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useState, useCallback } from 'react'\n\n// 基本用法\nfunction ParentComponent() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  // 每次渲染都会创建新的函数\n  const handleClickWithoutCallback = () => {\n    console.log('Button clicked')\n  }\n  \n  // 使用useCallback缓存函数\n  const handleClickWithCallback = useCallback(() => {\n    console.log('Button clicked')\n  }, []) // 空依赖数组，函数不会改变\n  \n  // 带依赖的useCallback\n  const handleClickWithValue = useCallback(() => {\n    console.log(`Count is ${count}`)\n  }, [count]) // 当count变化时，函数会重新创建\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>\n      <ChildComponent onClick={handleClickWithCallback} />\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 优化子组件渲染\nconst ChildComponent = React.memo(({ onClick }) => {\n  console.log('ChildComponent rendered')\n  return <button onClick={onClick}>Child Button</button>\n})\n\n// 实际应用场景：事件处理器\nfunction TodoList() {\n  const [todos, setTodos] = useState([\n    { id: 1, text: 'Learn React', completed: false },\n    { id: 2, text: 'Write Code', completed: false }\n  ])\n  \n  // 使用useCallback优化事件处理器\n  const handleToggle = useCallback((id) => {\n    setTodos(prevTodos =>\n      prevTodos.map(todo =>\n        todo.id === id ? { ...todo, completed: !todo.completed } : todo\n      )\n    )\n  }, [])\n  \n  const handleDelete = useCallback((id) => {\n    setTodos(prevTodos => prevTodos.filter(todo => todo.id !== id))\n  }, [])\n  \n  return (\n    <ul>\n      {todos.map(todo => (\n        <TodoItem\n          key={todo.id}\n          todo={todo}\n          onToggle={handleToggle}\n          onDelete={handleDelete}\n        />\n      ))}\n    </ul>\n  )\n}\n\nconst TodoItem = React.memo(({ todo, onToggle, onDelete }) => {\n  return (\n    <li>\n      <input\n        type=\"checkbox\"\n        checked={todo.completed}\n        onChange={() => onToggle(todo.id)}\n      />\n      <span style={{ textDecoration: todo.completed ? 'line-through' : 'none' }}>\n        {todo.text}\n      </span>\n      <button onClick={() => onDelete(todo.id)}>Delete</button>\n    </li>\n  )\n})\n```\n\n### useMemo Hook\n\nuseMemo用于缓存计算结果，避免重复计算。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useState, useMemo } from 'react'\n\n// 基本用法\nfunction ExpensiveCalculation({ a, b }) {\n  // 使用useMemo缓存计算结果\n  const result = useMemo(() => {\n    console.log('Performing expensive calculation...')\n    // 模拟耗时计算\n    let result = 0\n    for (let i = 0; i < 1000000; i++) {\n      result += a * b\n    }\n    return result\n  }, [a, b]) // 只有当a或b变化时才重新计算\n  \n  return <div>Result: {result}</div>\n}\n\nfunction Calculator() {\n  const [a, setA] = useState(10)\n  const [b, setB] = useState(20)\n  const [counter, setCounter] = useState(0)\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <div>\n        <input value={a} onChange={e => setA(Number(e.target.value))} />\n        <input value={b} onChange={e => setB(Number(e.target.value))} />\n      </div>\n      \n      <ExpensiveCalculation a={a} b={b} />\n      \n      <div>\n        <p>Counter: {counter}</p>\n        <button onClick={() => setCounter(counter + 1)}>Increment Counter</button>\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 实际应用场景：过滤和排序\nfunction UserList({ users, filter, sortBy }) {\n  // 使用useMemo缓存过滤和排序结果\n  const filteredAndSortedUsers = useMemo(() => {\n    console.log('Filtering and sorting users...')\n    \n    let result = [...users]\n    \n    // 过滤\n    if (filter) {\n      result = result.filter(user =>\n        user.name.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase())\n      )\n    }\n    \n    // 排序\n    if (sortBy) {\n      result.sort((a, b) => {\n        if (sortBy === 'name') {\n          return a.name.localeCompare(b.name)\n        } else if (sortBy === 'age') {\n          return a.age - b.age\n        }\n        return 0\n      })\n    }\n    \n    return result\n  }, [users, filter, sortBy])\n  \n  return (\n    <ul>\n      {filteredAndSortedUsers.map(user => (\n        <li key={user.id}>\n          {user.name} (Age: {user.age})\n        </li>\n      ))}\n    </ul>\n  )\n}\n\n// 使用useMemo缓存复杂对象\nfunction Chart({ data, options }) {\n  // 缓存图表配置对象\n  const chartOptions = useMemo(() => ({\n    ...options,\n    responsive: true,\n    plugins: {\n      legend: {\n        position: 'top',\n      },\n      title: {\n        display: true,\n        text: 'Chart Title'\n      }\n    }\n  }), [options])\n  \n  // 缓存图表数据\n  const chartData = useMemo(() => ({\n    labels: data.map(item => item.label),\n    datasets: [\n      {\n        label: 'Dataset',\n        data: data.map(item => item.value),\n        backgroundColor: 'rgba(54, 162, 235, 0.2)',\n        borderColor: 'rgba(54, 162, 235, 1)',\n        borderWidth: 1\n      }\n    ]\n  }), [data])\n  \n  return <div>Chart with options and data</div>\n}\n```\n\n### useRef Hook\n\nuseRef用于获取DOM元素引用或在多次渲染之间保存可变值。\n\n```javascript\nimport React, { useRef, useEffect, useState } from 'react'\n\n// 获取DOM元素引用\nfunction TextInputWithFocusButton() {\n  const inputEl = useRef(null)\n  \n  const onButtonClick = () => {\n    // `current` 指向已挂载到 DOM 上的文本输入元素\n    inputEl.current.focus()\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <input ref={inputEl} type=\"text\" />\n      <button onClick={onButtonClick}>Focus the input</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 保存可变值\nfunction Timer() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  const intervalRef = useRef()\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    intervalRef.current = setInterval(() => {\n      setCount(prevCount => prevCount + 1)\n    }, 1000)\n    \n    return () => {\n      clearInterval(intervalRef.current)\n    }\n  }, [])\n  \n  const handleStop = () => {\n    clearInterval(intervalRef.current)\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <p>Count: {count}</p>\n      <button onClick={handleStop}>Stop Timer</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 获取上一轮的props或state\nfunction usePrevious(value) {\n  const ref = useRef()\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    ref.current = value\n  })\n  \n  return ref.current\n}\n\nfunction Counter() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  const prevCount = usePrevious(count)\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>Now: {count}, before: {prevCount}</h1>\n      <button onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Increment</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook中使用useRef\nfunction useInterval(callback, delay) {\n  const savedCallback = useRef()\n  \n  // 保存最新的callback\n  useEffect(() => {\n    savedCallback.current = callback\n  }, [callback])\n  \n  // 设置interval\n  useEffect(() => {\n    function tick() {\n      savedCallback.current()\n    }\n    \n    if (delay !== null) {\n      const id = setInterval(tick, delay)\n      return () => clearInterval(id)\n    }\n  }, [delay])\n}\n\nfunction Counter() {\n  const [count, setCount] = useState(0)\n  \n  useInterval(() => {\n    setCount(count + 1)\n  }, 1000)\n  \n  return <h1>{count}</h1>\n}\n```\n\n## 自定义Hooks\n\n自定义Hooks是复用状态逻辑的强大方式，它遵循与内置Hooks相同的规则。\n\n### 创建自定义Hooks\n\n```javascript\nimport { useState, useEffect } from 'react'\n\n// 自定义Hook：数据获取\nfunction useFetch(url) {\n  const [data, setData] = useState(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  const [error, setError] = useState(null)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const fetchData = async () => {\n      try {\n        setLoading(true)\n        const response = await fetch(url)\n        const data = await response.json()\n        setData(data)\n      } catch (err) {\n        setError(err.message)\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    fetchData()\n  }, [url])\n  \n  return { data, loading, error }\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction UserProfile({ userId }) {\n  const { data: user, loading, error } = useFetch(`https://api.example.com/users/${userId}`)\n  \n  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  if (error) return <div>Error: {error}</div>\n  if (!user) return <div>No user found</div>\n  \n  return <div>{user.name}</div>\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：本地存储\nfunction useLocalStorage(key, initialValue) {\n  // 获取初始值\n  const [storedValue, setStoredValue] = useState(() => {\n    try {\n      const item = window.localStorage.getItem(key)\n      return item ? JSON.parse(item) : initialValue\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(`Error reading localStorage key \"${key}\":`, error)\n      return initialValue\n    }\n  })\n  \n  // 更新值的函数\n  const setValue = (value) => {\n    try {\n      // 允许value是函数，类似useState\n      const valueToStore = value instanceof Function ? value(storedValue) : value\n      setStoredValue(valueToStore)\n      window.localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(valueToStore))\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(`Error setting localStorage key \"${key}\":`, error)\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return [storedValue, setValue]\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction App() {\n  const [name, setName] = useLocalStorage('name', 'React')\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <input\n        type=\"text\"\n        value={name}\n        onChange={e => setName(e.target.value)}\n      />\n      <p>Hello, {name}!</p>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：防抖\nfunction useDebounce(value, delay) {\n  const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] = useState(value)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handler = setTimeout(() => {\n      setDebouncedValue(value)\n    }, delay)\n    \n    return () => {\n      clearTimeout(handler)\n    }\n  }, [value, delay])\n  \n  return debouncedValue\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction SearchComponent() {\n  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('')\n  const debouncedSearchTerm = useDebounce(searchTerm, 500)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 使用防抖后的搜索词进行API调用\n    if (debouncedSearchTerm) {\n      console.log('Searching for:', debouncedSearchTerm)\n    }\n  }, [debouncedSearchTerm])\n  \n  return (\n    <input\n      type=\"text\"\n      value={searchTerm}\n      onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}\n      placeholder=\"Search...\"\n    />\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：窗口大小\nfunction useWindowSize() {\n  const [windowSize, setWindowSize] = useState({\n    width: window.innerWidth,\n    height: window.innerHeight\n  })\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    const handleResize = () => {\n      setWindowSize({\n        width: window.innerWidth,\n        height: window.innerHeight\n      })\n    }\n    \n    window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n    \n    return () => window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize)\n  }, [])\n  \n  return windowSize\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction WindowSizeComponent() {\n  const { width, height } = useWindowSize()\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      Window size: {width} x {height}\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\n// 自定义Hook：权限控制\nfunction useAuth() {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  \n  useEffect(() => {\n    // 检查用户是否已登录\n    const checkAuth = async () => {\n      try {\n        const token = localStorage.getItem('token')\n        if (token) {\n          const response = await fetch('/api/auth/me', {\n            headers: {\n              Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`\n            }\n          })\n          \n          if (response.ok) {\n            const userData = await response.json()\n            setUser(userData)\n          } else {\n            localStorage.removeItem('token')\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error('Auth check failed:', error)\n      } finally {\n        setLoading(false)\n      }\n    }\n    \n    checkAuth()\n  }, [])\n  \n  const login = async (credentials) => {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/auth/login', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: {\n          'Content-Type': 'application/json'\n        },\n        body: JSON.stringify(credentials)\n      })\n      \n      if (response.ok) {\n        const { token, user } = await response.json()\n        localStorage.setItem('token', token)\n        setUser(user)\n        return { success: true }\n      } else {\n        const error = await response.json()\n        return { success: false, error: error.message }\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      return { success: false, error: error.message }\n    }\n  }\n  \n  const logout = () => {\n    localStorage.removeItem('token')\n    setUser(null)\n  }\n  \n  return { user, loading, login, logout }\n}\n\n// 使用自定义Hook\nfunction AuthComponent() {\n  const { user, loading, login, logout } = useAuth()\n  \n  if (loading) return <div>Loading...</div>\n  \n  if (!user) {\n    return <LoginForm onLogin={login} />\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    <div>\n      <h1>Welcome, {user.name}!</h1>\n      <button onClick={logout}>Logout</button>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n```"
